package main

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-api-engine/lib/apiengine"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-api-engine/lib/wire"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-api-engine/testhelper"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-errors-problems/lib/problem"
)

// This consumer reaches every exported symbol the module publishes, so the
// production deadcode pass measures the library as a consumer sees it rather
// than reporting the whole public surface as unreachable.
func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()

	// lib/wire — the C0 section 1 wire codecs.
	timeout, _ := wire.ParseDuration("PT10S")
	_ = timeout.Std()
	_ = timeout.String()
	_, _ = timeout.MarshalJSON()
	_ = timeout.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`"PT10S"`))

	instant, _ := wire.ParseInstant("2026-07-25T19:35:00Z")
	_ = wire.NewInstant(instant.Std())
	_ = instant.Std()
	_ = instant.String()
	_, _ = instant.MarshalJSON()
	_ = instant.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`"2026-07-25T19:35:00Z"`))

	zone, _ := wire.ParseZone("UTC")
	_ = zone.String()
	_, _ = zone.Location()
	_, _ = zone.MarshalJSON()
	_ = zone.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`"UTC"`))
	_ = wire.ErrDuration
	_ = wire.ErrInstant
	_ = wire.ErrZone

	// lib/apiengine — problems, config, classification, client, tree.
	problems, _ := apiengine.NewProblems(problem.LocalErrorPortal())
	_ = apiengine.ProblemTypes()
	_ = problems.Registry()
	_, _ = problems.Catalog()
	_ = problems.Raise(apiengine.ProblemTransport, "d", nil)
	_ = problems.RaiseFrom(apiengine.ProblemConfigInvalid, http.ErrNotSupported, "d", nil)
	_ = apiengine.ProblemVersion
	_ = apiengine.ProblemResponseUnreadable
	_ = apiengine.ProblemResponseUndecodable
	_ = apiengine.ProblemResponseNotProblem
	_ = apiengine.ProblemBackendUnregistered
	_ = apiengine.ProblemRequestUnbuildable
	_ = apiengine.ProblemCredentialsUnavailable

	config := apiengine.DefaultConfig()
	config.Backends["api"] = apiengine.BackendConfig{BaseURL: "https://example.invalid"}
	_ = config.Names()
	_ = config.Resource("api")
	_ = config.Validate(problems)
	_, _ = config.Tree(nil)
	_ = apiengine.ConfigBlockSchema()
	_ = apiengine.ConfigBlockKey
	_ = apiengine.DefaultTimeout
	_ = config.Backends["api"].RequestTimeout()
	_ = apiengine.RetryConfig{Network: true, Delay: timeout}

	_ = apiengine.Classify(200, nil)
	_ = apiengine.OutcomeSuccess.String()
	_ = apiengine.OutcomeProblem
	_ = apiengine.OutcomeTransport
	_, _ = apiengine.DecodeProblem([]byte(`{"type":"https://x","title":"t"}`))

	tree, _ := apiengine.NewClientTree(apiengine.TreeOptions{
		Config: config, Problems: problems, Doer: http.DefaultClient,
	})
	_ = tree.Names()
	_ = tree.Problems()
	client, _ := tree.Backend("api")
	_ = client.Backend()
	_ = client.BaseURL()
	_, _ = client.Call(ctx, apiengine.Request{Path: "/x"})
	_, _ = apiengine.Execute[map[string]any](ctx, client, apiengine.Request{Path: "/x"})
	_ = apiengine.Send(ctx, client, apiengine.Request{Path: "/x"})

	var _ apiengine.Doer = http.DefaultClient
	_ = apiengine.Response{}
	_ = apiengine.ClientOptions{}
	_, _ = apiengine.NewClient(apiengine.ClientOptions{})

	// testhelper — the consumer-facing fakes and assertions.
	backend := testhelper.NewFakeBackend(testhelper.FakeBackendOptions{})
	defer backend.Close()
	_ = backend.URL()
	_ = backend.Requests()
	_ = backend.Count()
	backend.SetRoute("/x", testhelper.Route{Status: 200})
	_ = backend.Backend()
	_ = testhelper.RecordedRequest{}.Authorization()

	_ = testhelper.ProblemResponse(testhelper.ProblemOptions{})
	_ = testhelper.Canned(testhelper.ProblemOptions{})
	_ = testhelper.SampleErrorPortal()
	_, _ = testhelper.NewProblems()

	retriever := testhelper.NewFakeRetriever(map[string]string{"api": "token"})
	retriever.FailResource("other", http.ErrNotSupported)
	_, _ = retriever.Token(ctx, "api")
	_ = retriever.Asked()

	fake, _ := testhelper.NewFakeTree(testhelper.FakeTreeOptions{
		Backends: map[string]*testhelper.FakeBackend{"api": backend},
	})
	fake.Close()

	_, _ = testhelper.CheckProblem(nil, testhelper.ProblemOptions{})
	_ = testhelper.CheckOutcome(apiengine.OutcomeSuccess, apiengine.OutcomeSuccess)
	_ = testhelper.CheckCount(backend, 0)
	var recorder testhelper.TestingT
	_ = testhelper.AssertProblem(recorder, nil, testhelper.ProblemOptions{})
	testhelper.AssertOutcome(recorder, apiengine.OutcomeSuccess, apiengine.OutcomeSuccess)
	testhelper.AssertCount(recorder, backend, 0)
}
